1.2.4.7-r11.burton_quote: A young Gentlewoman in Basel, was married, saith Felix Plater, observat. lib. 1, to an ancient man against her will

1.2.4.7-r12.burton_quote: especially if they be generous spirits, scarce anything affects them more, than to be despised or vilified

1.2.4.7-r13.burton_quote: but upon a sudden they began to be so troubled in their brains, and their fantasy so crazed, that they thought they were in a ship at sea, and now ready to be cast away by reason of a tempest. Wherefore to avoid shipwreck and present drowning, they flung all the goods in the house out at the windows into the street, or into the sea, as they supposed

1.2.4.7-r14.burton_quote: he would build an Altar to their service

1.2.4.7-r15.burton_quote: which dry up the body, increase cares, diminish sleep
1.2.4.7-r15.translation: which, when carried about, make one unhappy and sad

1.2.4.7-r2.burton_quote: had a patient troubled with this infirmity, by reason of her husband’s death

1.2.4.7-r3.burton_quote: that grew desperate upon his mother’s death

1.2.4.7-r4.burton_quote: Loss of friends, and loss of goods, make many men melancholy, as I have often seen by continual meditation of such things
1.2.4.7-r4.translation: with no hope of recovering them

1.2.4.7-r5.burton_quote: Churches were turned to stables, old monuments and books, made horse-litter, or burned like straw; relics, costly pictures defaced; altars demolished, rich hangings, carpets, &c., trampled in the dirt
1.2.4.7-r5.translation: Temples stripped of their ornaments and plundered; [stables] for horses and asses; sacred fillets trodden on the ground and befouled, etc. ["Insulae" read as infulae and "peditae" as foedatae.]

1.2.4.7-r6.burton_quote: Their wives & loveliest daughters constuprated by every base cullion, as Sejanus’ daughter was by the hangman in public, before their fathers’ and husbands’ faces. Noblemen’s children, and of the wealthiest citizens, reserved for Princes’ beds

1.2.4.7-r7.burton_quote: Those proud palaces that even now vaunted their tops up to Heaven, were dejected as low as hell in an instant

1.2.4.7-r8.burton_quote: they pull those misfortunes they suspect, up on their own heads
